description: Weekly Search Console report (owner request 2026-10-20). Bounded run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run gsc_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which reads the server-held service account key and only GETs/queries Search Console (permission, sitemaps, top queries/pages for 28 days, index status of every sitemap page). The key never leaves the server; the report is checked for key material. No source, CRM, HTML, media or bot change.
title: Weekly Search Console report
